checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Dark sky, dark street, lamps lit.

must.item: Street and shop architecture keep shapes and positions
must.why: Layout matches; minor detail changes in upper facades and shop interior.

must.item: Pedestrian on right, same pose, blue jacket
must.why: Man is in the same place, pose and blue jacket.
Warm lamp and window glow, no harsh daylight.

must.item: Wide composition preserved, no new subjects/objects
must.why: Same framing; no obvious new subjects.

faults.what: Shop sign and window interior details slightly altered (a new object appears in the left window, the sign text changed).
Upper facades are very dark and lose detail; the second lamp is only dimly lit.

summary: A convincing night version of the same street with the man and woman in place and lamps and windows lit, with only minor detail drift in the signs and shop interiors.
